newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH SHELL CUTS/RAISES GASOLINE, DIESEL PRICES.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH SHELL CUTS/RAISES GASOLINE, DIESEL PRICES.

text.p: Royal Dutch/Shell unit Shell Nederland BV said on Friday it will raise its retail price for diesel in the Netherlands by 1.2 cents per litre with effect from September 2.
The move reflects changes in international product prices and the value of the dollar against the guilder, Shell said.
From Monday the price of diesel at Shell's self-service stations goes up to 1.432 guilders per litre.
The prices of unleaded gasolines and of premium gasoline with lead substitute remain unchanged.
